key.name: window-width
key.description: The width of the main window in pixels.

key.name: window-height
key.description: The height of the main window in pixels.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Whether the main window is maximized.

key.name: close-notice-shown
key.description: Whether the user has been told that closing the window leaves the sync service running. Shown only once.

key.name: autostart
key.description: Whether Halyard has been granted autostart through the XDG Background portal. This mirrors the portal's answer; the portal remains the source of truth.
